title: Separate source prediction, trajectory diagnosis and causal necessity
decision: A causally prior source state cannot identify responses that depend on unseen later context; a downstream camera may diagnose the realized response, but neither multi-event nor final-state observational sufficiency establishes a minimal causal path.
authorizes: explicitly typed observation contracts
physical rescue and blocking calibration
forbids: call final-boundary sufficiency a one-node mechanism

title: Block pretrained escalation after identity-conditioned handoff breadth failure
decision: C005 closes after the frozen one-shot handoff test; two of six full passes do not authorize Qwen3. A future campaign must change and independently calibrate the causal-edge or identity-geometry object.
authorizes: known-truth causal-edge recalibration under a new contract

title: Replace text-position handoff groups with typed causal-edge calibration
decision: A future mechanism object must be defined by native QK/OV/MLP intervention roles, identity rescue and complete causal cuts rather than source/mapping text-position groups. Planted recovery is an instrument calibration, not a language result.
authorizes: free-network typed-edge external validity
forbids: infer mechanism identity from output behavior

title: Require arithmetic-executor identity before intervention interpretation
decision: Training, natural evaluation and intervention must share an arithmetically equivalent executor within a frozen tolerance. Executor qualification is a prerequisite, not a mechanism gate.
authorizes: same-executor terminal correction
interpret qualified free-network intervention spectra
forbids: repeat executor variants after the terminal correction

title: Authorize exactly one scoped Qwen3 typed-coalition test
decision: The same-executor breadth result authorizes one fresh Qwen3-4B FP16 contract with behavior-first trace capture, fixed Q/OV/MLP roles and conjunctive rescue, identity, null and reverse-block controls.

title: Close local typed-edge campaign after Qwen3 matched-null failure
decision: The Qwen3 eight-OV coalition is a strong output-proximal transport candidate but not a content-specific mechanism because matched-null response exceeded the frozen ceiling. C009 closes without threshold repair or another pretrained run.
authorizes: document the full C006-C009 calibration ladder
design a future campaign only around genuinely new intervention semantics or a natural object contract

title: Separate target-axis identity transport from orthogonal contextual transport
decision: C010 shows that a newly selected late head/MLP coalition can transport queried identity almost exactly while still carrying a target-orthogonal contextual response that fails held-out template specificity. These are separate evidence axes.
authorizes: design a future mechanism-truth causal mediation or subspace-selective instrument
forbids: call direct identity success semantic closure

title: Close linear null-zero external validity and require complete factorial intervention semantics
decision: C011 shows that selective operators and mediation can be calibrated when mechanism truth supports global or typed separation, but the unchanged linear target-preserve/null-zero camera yields no two-event object in six behavior-qualified free Transformers. C011 closes. A future campaign must preserve and predict the complete factorial A/B/J response rather than define every matched-null response as nuisance by construction.
authorizes: preregister a new known-truth factorial response-preserving compiler competition
forbids: claim untested path mediation is negative

title: Close C012 at known-truth type failure and separate generator identity from predictive equivalence
decision: C012 preserves complete factorial A/B/J effects and calibrates its applicable prediction, specificity, path and abstention subcomponents, but its exact generative-family type gate fails because five smooth generators are observationally sufficient under earlier candidate classes and two manifold tails fail. C012 closes before free-network execution. A future campaign must define the estimand as a cross-fitted predictive functional equivalence class with explicit complexity order and margins, not repair C012 to recover hidden generator names.
authorizes: design a new predictive-equivalence campaign with margin-separated known truth
forbids: call the result a language mechanism

title: Close C013 at the finite-sample abstention boundary and preserve independent rescue separately
decision: C013 validates predictive functional equivalence as a better estimand than generator labels and calibrates independently sourced donor rescue in known truth, but two equivalence-overlap systems crossed the frozen point-risk boundary between reference and selection panels. Exact typed abstention therefore fails and C013 closes before free-network execution. Algebraic replay remains a leakage sentinel with zero mediation evidence.
authorizes: design a new interval-valued or stability-certified functional quotient under a fresh campaign
forbids: increase only the same selection panel after unblinding
